decision_unlocks.reason: Migrate from Windows Services (node-windows) to WSL2 + systemd architecture. Windows Service model has limitations for managing 40+ services: no native dependency ordering, requires custom .NET self-healing service, no cgroup resource limits, Docker Desktop overhead. WSL2 + systemd provides native Linux process supervision, declarative After=/Requires= dependency chains, Docker Engine without Desktop overhead, cgroups v2 for memory/CPU limits, and industry-standard observability with Prometheus/Grafana.

current_pain_points: node-windows requires manual service registration per manager
No native dependency ordering between services
Self-healing relies on custom .NET worker polling
Docker Desktop required on Windows (memory overhead)
proposed_benefits: systemd provides native service supervision with watchdog
Declarative After=/Requires= dependency chains for boot ordering
Native Docker Engine (no Docker Desktop overhead)
cgroups v2 for memory/CPU limits per service
